title: Deep cross-implementation route, claim, and failure-shape reconciliation
mode: Primary-source comparative research and local plan-owner crosswalk; research-only
scope: Compare public version/operation support statements against project-documented limitations and issue reports for LibreDWG, ACadSharp, ezdxf, and FreeCAD.
Cross-reference reported loss, malformed output, parser robustness, and semantic failures against current local plan owners.
Refine implementation readiness and evidence rules without duplicating findings or changing routine validation cadence.

sources.revision: Mutable master documentation and issue pages reviewed 2026-10-19; runtime behavior remains revision-specific
sources.observed: The manual separately marks stable, halfway, unhandled, and untested families; it notes absent R2007 DWG writing and R2010-R2018 CRC/audit limitations. Open reports describe AcDs/SAB carrier loss, string emission defects, CMC color-index confusion, incomplete output, and unresolved-reference interruption. These are issue-level peer observations, not local reproductions or universal claims about current LibreDWG.

sources.revision: Mutable README and issue pages reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The README's operation/version matrix is a declared route map. Current reports identify separate MTEXT native-rejection, DWG-to-DXF spline, repeated-token parser recursion, and EED length narrowing shapes. The spline issue names a package and includes an attachment, but its public body does not identify exact bad arrays or an independent curve. Reports and current source must not be conflated with a formal release artifact.

The project declares ASCII/Binary DXF read/write version support from R12 through R2018 at listed milestones and third-party-content retention; DWG access is via optional ODA File Converter. Import/copy operations have entity/object limitations, and ACIS support is described only as added/basic. It is a bounded DXF codec/generator/checker, not an independent DWG implementation or general ACIS-kernel oracle.

sources.revision: Public docs/source/issues reviewed 2026-10-19; documentation repository page states it was archived 2026-04-01
sources.observed: DWG uses an external converter to DXF followed by a selected DXF importer. The documented C++ and legacy Python importers have different family coverage; stock routes do not read embedded ACIS/SAT solids. This defines a consumer-route boundary only; it does not qualify a particular installed FreeCAD binary or converter.

sources.revision: Open Design Specification for DWG v5.4.1
sources.observed: Remains the controlling byte-layout source for DWG implementation changes; peer implementations and issue reports are not normative substitutes. This research pass did not change any parser grammar.

assessment.planImpact: Clarifies route-specific oracle scope, strengthens structure-versus-semantics and output-finalization checks, and maps current peer failure shapes to existing local owners. Does not create duplicate work or promote any implementation/support claim.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web review plus local plan-owner crosswalk
method.limitations: Issue pages are mutable, peer-reported observations and may reflect unreleased or stale package/source states. Public support matrices are declarations, not per-family conformance evidence. FreeCAD documentation is descriptive of documented routes, and its documentation repository is archived; the exact runtime must be pinned during native qualification. No current peer build or local reproduction was performed.

implementationReadyChecks: At the existing composed checkpoint, compare only a concrete unresolved local family and bind tool artifact/source revision, direction, version, runtime/platform, hashes, and per-handle/type/owner disposition.
Use a generated minimal valid case, following sentinel, and nearby negative/positive control before changing local parser or writer behavior from a peer report.
For outputs, check group/value framing, section and EOF closure, references, and fail-closed publication before treating an independent reader's result as semantic evidence.
Keep FreeCAD converter, DXF version, importer backend/settings, and consumer scope explicit; mark unsupported stock ACIS paths as not applicable.
Keep opaque modeler payload retention, owner association, independent ACIS parsing, topology/analytic validity, and native regeneration as separate gates.
Do not add peer dependencies, downloaded fixtures, native runs, or full suites to ordinary fast implementation slices.
